 EPFO PF Account Update | How To Correct Details Online In 5 Easy Steps
 Incorrect information in PF account can hold up money: How to make corrections online; update details in 5 easy steps
 4 hours ago 
 Copy link 
 If any detail, such as your name, date of birth or gender, has been entered incorrectly in your PF account, your money may get stuck during claim settlement, fund withdrawal or account transfer.
 To address this problem, EPFO has shared details of its online joint declaration facility. With its help, members can correct their records from home without having to make repeated visits to an office.
 5 Easy Steps to Correct PF Details Online 
 Go to the EPFO portal and log in using your UAN number and password.
 After logging in, click on the Joint Declaration facility provided on the portal.
 Select the information you want to change and enter the correct data.
 Upload the required documents, such as your Aadhaar, PAN and birth certificate, in support of the correct information.
 Review all the details entered and the uploaded documents, then submit the request.
 Recorded Information Must Match the Documents 
 You will need to upload a valid government identity document corresponding to the information that needs to be corrected. Ensure that the information being entered exactly matches the document being uploaded.
 Process After Submitting the Request Online 
 Once you submit your correction request and documents on the member portal, the request will be forwarded for verification. Your details will be checked in accordance with EPFO rules and the verification process, after which the data will be updated.
 What Is the Joint Declaration Facility? 
 A joint declaration is a form submitted jointly by the employee and employer. It is used to correct the personal or employment-related details of a PF account member in official records. Earlier, members had to fill out the form physically and visit the PF office, but this can now be done online through the member portal.
 How to avoid having your PF claim rejected? 
 UAN-Aadhaar Linking: Ensure that your UAN is linked to Aadhaar and that the spelling of your name is exactly the same in both places.
 Bank Detail Verification: Keep your bank account's IFSC code and account number updated correctly so that the withdrawal amount is credited directly to your bank account.
 Profile Photo and Mobile Number: Keep your active mobile number and profile photo updated on the portal to avoid any problems during OTP verification.
